item.title: Blaney proud of team effort after another race of pit road miscues
item.description: Blaney had to come through the field to secure his third-place finish at Darlington after a series of pit road issues threatened to derail his race.

item.title: Capps, Langdon, Glenn roll to wins at NHRA Arizona Nationals
item.description: Three-time Funny Car world champion Ron Capps recovered from a massive engine explosion in the second round to earn his 78th career win. Shawn Langdon (Top Fuel) and Dallas Glenn (Pro Stock) also won.

item.title: Development opportunities, not compression ratio changes will help Ferrari close the gap - Vasseur
item.description: The Additional Development and Upgrade Opportunities (ADUO) will be a bigger factor in Ferrari finding engine performance, not changes to compression ratio tests, says Fred Vasseur.

item.title: Aston Martin making progress, but ‘cannot produce miracles’ - Krack
item.description: The small gaps between the first three races of the season means that Aston Martin has only been able to make small steps so far.

item.title: What's going on with McLaren?
item.description: Coming into the season as defending champions McLaren had high expectations, but why has it failed to make an impression on the title fight early on?

item.title: No matter what you change, Darlington is who she is
item.description: No matter what NASCAR does to the technical package, Darlington will always be Darlington. That's a good thing, as Kelly Crandall explains.

item.description: Manthey's famed 'Grello' Porsche 911 has won the Nurburgring 24 Hours seven times, now it has a Sebring 12 Hours victory win, too.
